messages:
Eloise: FYI HelioSys is stuck on MediScale private deploy. Sidecar can't reach our KMS proxy after image boots. They suspect egress/port mapping. :thinking:
Marco: Can you paste the exact sidecar log and which AWS account/VPC they're in?
Eloise: From HelioSys (redacted):
```
[2026-03-21T09:04:12Z] sidecar: dial tcp 10.12.9.8:8443: connect: connection timed out
sidecar: attempts=4 target=proxy.private.redwood.svc:8443
```
They claim 8443 is permitted per their FW but packets never reach control-plane proxy. Region: us-west-2, using TGW, cross-account peering.
Priya: Quick check 1: our private-proxy mode puts the proxy in control-plane account. Traffic traverses TGW attachments and policy table. Any recent TGW policy changes?
Marco: Yes, we deployed a marketplace hardening policy Tuesday that added a deny for ephemeral ports and tightened allowed ports on the transit route. I see an explicit deny for tcp:8443 on the partner transit route.
Dan: That would explain it. MediScale go-live is Friday though. Can HelioSys change sidecar to 443 temporarily?
Eloise: They tried 443 and handshakes complete, but the sidecar validates cert SANs against port 8443 during mTLS auth so it fails post-handshake. Not a simple port flip.
Marco: Two safe options: 1) add a scoped allow in TGW for HelioSys VPC CIDR -> control-proxy:8443, keeping the global deny; or 2) patch sidecar image to redirect 8443->443 with iptables or an init container.
Priya: Security preference is scoped allow + audit tag. We avoid image rebuilds. But we need approval from sec-ops for any exceptions.
Dan: I'll pull sec-ops into thread. Eloise, ask HelioSys if they're ok with a temporary iptables redirect while we process the exception. Provide this snippet:
```bash
sudo iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 8443 -j REDIRECT --to-port 443
```
Eloise: Pinged HelioSys; they prefer not to touch images but can apply the iptables workaround on the host as short-term. They want the TGW exception for long-term.
integrations-bot: Ticket created PARTNER-5392 1 "HelioSys MediScale private-proxy 8443 blocked by TGW policy; request scoped allow or sidecar redirect". Assigned: Marco, Priya. SLA: 4h review.
Marco: I'll draft the minimal TGW policy diff and include justification and rollback plan for sec-ops. Will scope by partner VPC CIDR and tag with PARTNER-5392.
Priya: Also logging item: add a post-deploy check in marketplace hardening playbook to run a whitelist impact scan against active private deployments to avoid regressions.
Eloise: HelioSys confirmed the iptables redirect worked end-to-end and auth succeeded. They're standing by for the TGW change.
Dan: Good. Marco, proceed with exception after sec-ops approval and notify HelioSys so they can remove the temporary redirect. Keep me posted.
Marco: Will do. I'll post policy diff and sec-ops approval here when ready. :thumbsup:
Eloise: Thanks all 1 closing once TGW diff applied and partner verifies removal of iptables hack.
